assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with a measurable-space structure identified with its Borel structure. V is ContDiff ℝ 2. α and β are nonnegative real numbers with 0<α and α≤β. For every x,v∈E, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖², with genuine second Fréchet derivative and real Hilbert gradient. η>0 and βη≤1. Measurability of observables and, where required, their everywhere nonnegative constant bounds or their MemLp properties are local hypotheses of the respective clauses. All let-bindings, including laws, histories, path stitching, measures and auxiliary densities, are definitions, not additional assumptions. There is no positive-dimension assumption, restriction on y,r,z₀, assumed process regularity, assumed nonexplosion, or assumed semigroup law.
conclusion: A jointly measurable globally defined Z obeys the exact pointwise record-based flow formula and pointwise fallback and is initialized P-almost surely for each parameter triple. At every horizon its endpoint preserves ν_y, and bounded measurable observables satisfy the two stated integrability conclusions and the R-twisted balance identity. Raw expectations of any measurable observable are jointly measurable; bounded observables have integrable noise sections and the same uniform sup bound. For each y,r a single real L² contraction family A realizes all raw square-integrable endpoint expectations, with ν_y-almost-everywhere noise integrability and the explicit squared-integral contraction. It has A₀=id and the convergence claim ∀f∈L²(ν_y), lim_{t→0,t≥0}‖A_t f−f‖₂=0. Momentum reversal preserves ν_y, its pullback J is an isometric involution, and A_T*=J A_T J. Position projection preserves ν_y to μ_y; its isometric pullback B and adjoint M satisfy ‖B‖,‖M‖≤1, MB=id, Gaussian averaging for every raw L² phase observable, JB=B and MJ=M. Kpos_T=M A_T B has Kpos₀=id, is self-adjoint and contractive for every T, and realizes the stated nested Gaussian/noise integral on every raw spatial L² function, with both asserted iterated AE integrability conclusions. No separate law for q, ρ, C or Γ, or global no-explosion/semigroup/Markov/long-time assertion, is in the conjunction.
constant_dependencies: The global existence witness Z may depend on E and its structures, V, α,β,η and the fixed assumptions; it is jointly parameterized by y,r,z₀,T,w rather than chosen separately for those arguments. The measures μ_y and ν_y depend on E,V,η,y, not r; P is the fixed unit-exponential product law. For each y,r the operator-family witness A may depend on both parameters and the fixed ambient data and Z, but is one choice for every T and every observable. The operators J and B are the specified canonical pullbacks after their measure-preservation witnesses, M is the adjoint of B and Kpos is the specified composition; none depends on an individual observable. Bounds C_F,C_G,C are arbitrary nonnegative constants supplied with pointwise bounds, not asserted to depend only on α,β,η or dimension. No convergence rate, mixing constant, spectral gap, positive-time continuity modulus, or uniform-in-parameter convergence is supplied.
domains: E is any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including rank zero. V:E→ℝ; α,β∈ℝ≥0; η∈ℝ. y,r∈E; initial states z₀∈H=E×E; n,k∈ℕ. Flow time t ranges over ℝ, while accumulated times, horizons T, residual times u and thresholds e range over ℝ≥0. τ and eventTime take values in WithTop ℝ≥0. Random input w:ℕ→ℝ has coordinate-product measurable structure and law P. Hist_n=Fin(n+1)→Rec; Prefix_n(T) is a subtype of Fin n→ℝ; Path(T)={s∈ℝ≥0:s≤T}→H. q and ρ take values in ℝ≥0∞; qReal, λ and Λ are real. Raw observables F,G:H→ℝ and f:E→ℝ. Phase operators act on real Hilbert L²(ν_y), spatial operators on real Hilbert L²(μ_y). Linear operators are continuous and bounded; J and B are linear isometries. All measurable structures are the displayed Borel/product/subtype structures.
objects: Phase space H=E×E, with x the first coordinate and p the second; parameters y and r=xRef are arbitrary fixed vectors. The flow Φ is the displayed oscillator about c=y−η∇V(r), S is reflection against g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), λ=√η max(0,⟨p,g_r(x)⟩), Λ is the integrated rate, and τ is its nonnegative threshold-hitting infimum, possibly infinity. Rec=([0,∞)×H)⊕Unit; next advances and reflects a live record or kills it on infinite τ, and preserves stopped records; record is this recursion from (0,z₀). P is the independent unit-exponential coordinate product on ℝ^ℕ and ε_k=(w_k)₊. history_n lists records 0 through n. readTime is the real live time or 0 if stopped; eventTime is the live nonnegative time or infinity if stopped. I_n(T) brackets T by eventTime_n≤T<eventTime_{n+1}; N selects the least such n, otherwise 0. Δ_n(T) consists of n real times 0<t₁<⋯<t_n<T; Prefix is its subtype and m is the comap of n-dimensional Lebesgue measure along subtype inclusion. With t₀=0, zAt_0=z₀ and zAt_{i+1}=SΦ(t_{i+1}−t_i,zAt_i); K is the live history ((t_i,zAt_i))_{i=0}^n, using toNNReal for times. qReal is ∏_{i=0}^{n−1}[λ(Φ(t_{i+1}−t_i,zAt_i)) exp(−Λ_{zAt_i}(t_{i+1}−t_i))]; q=ofReal(qReal). The admissible-history set A_n(T) requires all entries live, strictly increasing readTimes and every successor readTime<T; it does not itself require initial time 0 or initial state z₀. d=T minus the last liveTime, truncated at 0, with stopped liveTime=0. survival of a live record is u<τ(Real.toNNReal e), and is false if stopped; weight is ofReal(exp(−Λ(u))) if live and 0 if stopped. C requires the random history to belong to A_n(T) and the terminal residual interval to survive coordinate w_n. Path(T) is the set of all functions [0,T]→H without imposed regularity. Ψ folds through history indices in increasing order: each live record of time ≤s overwrites the current value with Φ(s−recordTime,recordState), starting from z₀; Γ=Ψ∘K. ρ=q times the terminal weight. R reverses p; μ_y is the specified tilted spatial measure, γ the standard Gaussian and ν_y=μ_y⊗γ. Z is the global process; A_T are its L² expectation realizations, J is R-pullback, B is position-pullback, M=B*, and Kpos_T=M A_T B. The finite-density/path auxiliaries are defined, not separately asserted to describe a distribution.

quantifiers: Universally fix E and its structures, V, α,β,η and all displayed hypotheses. Then there exists one jointly measurable Z working for every y,r,z₀,T,w. Its record formula and no-bracket fallback are universally pointwise in these parameters. Initialization has order ∀y ∀r ∀z₀, for P-almost every w. Endpoint preservation and bounded-observable twisted balance hold for every y,r,T, then every F,G and every nonnegative pointwise bounds C_F,C_G under their measurability and bound hypotheses. Expectation measurability has order ∀measurable G, jointly in (y,r,z,T); bounded-integrand conclusions then hold for every admissible C and all y,r,z,T. Next, for each y,r there exists a single family A indexed by all T≥0 satisfying A₀=id, ∀f strong convergence at 0, and ∀T contraction and all MemLp representation conclusions. This same existential choice includes hR, hence J, and hfst, hence B and M, simultaneously for all T and all raw MemLp functions. The MemLp witnesses for raw outputs may depend on those raw functions, their input MemLp witnesses and T. The projected-kernel statement is ∀T ∀raw f ∀hf:MemLp f 2 μ_y, followed by the two asserted iterated AE integrability statements and an output MemLp witness.
reconstructed_theorem_text:
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, with its Borel measurable structure and canonical volume; dimension zero is allowed. Let V:E→ℝ be twice continuously Fréchet differentiable. Let α,β be nonnegative real numbers with 0<α≤β, and suppose for every x,v∈E that α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖². Let η>0 and βη≤1. All conclusions below hold with these choices fixed.

For arbitrary y,r∈E write c=y−η∇V(r). For z=(x,p) and t∈ℝ define Φ_{y,r}(t,z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p). Put g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2⟨p,g_r(x)⟩g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), and λ_r(x,p)=√η max(0,⟨p,g_r(x)⟩). The displayed division is real totalized division, so S_r(x,p)=(x,p) when g_r(x)=0. For u≥0 let Λ_{y,r,z}(u)=∫₀ᵘ λ_r(Φ_{y,r}(s,z)) ds and τ_{y,r,z}(e)=inf{u≥0:Λ_{y,r,z}(u)≥e}, valued in [0,∞], with the empty infimum equal to infinity.

A live record consists of a nonnegative accumulated time and a phase state; there is also one stopped record. Starting with record₀=(0,z₀), a live record (t,z) and threshold e_k≥0 are replaced by the stopped record if τ_{y,r,z}(e_k)=∞, and otherwise by (t+τ_{y,r,z}(e_k), S_r(Φ_{y,r}(τ_{y,r,z}(e_k),z))). A stopped record remains stopped. Let P be the countable product of unit-rate exponential measures on real coordinates w_k, and use e_k=max(w_k,0). Let t_n(w) be the recorded time if record_n is live and infinity otherwise. For every T≥0 put I_n(T)={w:t_n(w)≤T<t_{n+1}(w)}.

Define R(x,p)=(x,−p), W_y(x)=V(x)+‖x−y‖²/(2η), μ_y=volume.tilted(−W_y), γ=stdGaussian(E), and ν_y=μ_y⊗γ. Precisely, the tilted spatial measure has density exp(−W_y(x))/(∫exp(−W_y) dvolume) against volume, interpreted using the given totalized real division and ENNReal.ofReal convention.

There exists one function Z(y,r,z₀,T,w)∈E×E, jointly measurable in all five displayed arguments, satisfying the following statements. For every y,r,z₀,w,T,n and every live record a=(a_time,a_state), if w∈I_n(T) and record_n=a, then Z(y,r,z₀,T,w)=Φ_{y,r}(T−a_time,a_state), where the time subtraction is nonnegative truncated subtraction. If no n satisfies w∈I_n(T), then Z(y,r,z₀,T,w)=z₀. For every y,r,z₀, initialization Z(y,r,z₀,0,w)=z₀ holds for P-almost every w; no common null set uniform over these parameters is asserted.

For every y,r,T define P_TG(z)=∫G(Z(y,r,z,T,w)) dP(w). The endpoint map (z,w)↦Z(y,r,z,T,w) is measure preserving from ν_y⊗P to ν_y. For all measurable real functions F,G on E×E and all real C_F,C_G≥0 such that |F(z)|≤C_F and |G(z)|≤C_G for every z, both F·P_TG and (G∘R)·P_T(F∘R) are integrable against ν_y and ∫F(z)P_TG(z) dν_y(z)=∫G(Rz)P_T(F∘R)(z) dν_y(z).

For every measurable real G on E×E, the raw real integral (y,r,z,T)↦∫G(Z(y,r,z,T,w)) dP(w) is jointly measurable, even without an integrability hypothesis on G; no integrability for arbitrary unbounded G is asserted. If a real C≥0 bounds |G| everywhere, then for every y,r,z,T the integrand in w is P-integrable and the absolute value of this expectation is at most C.

For every y,r there exists a family A_T of continuous real linear operators on L²(ν_y), indexed by T≥0, such that A₀ is the identity and, for every f∈L²(ν_y), A_t f→f in L² norm as t→0 within the nonnegative reals. This is a strong-at-zero convergence assertion, not an assertion of operator-norm convergence. For every T≥0, ‖A_T‖≤1. For every raw G with MemLp G 2 ν_y, the function w↦G(Z(y,r,z,T,w)) is P-integrable for ν_y-almost every z; the raw expectation P_TG belongs to L²(ν_y), A_T[G]=[P_TG], and ∫|P_TG|² dν_y≤∫|G|² dν_y.

For each y,r, this family A can be chosen together with a measure-preservation witness for R on ν_y. Its canonical real linear isometric pullback J on L²(ν_y) satisfies (Jf)(z)=f(Rz) for ν_y-almost every z for every f, J²f=f for every f, and A_T*=J A_T J for every T≥0.

There also exists a measure-preservation witness for the projection π(x,p)=x from ν_y to μ_y. Let B:L²(μ_y)→L²(ν_y) be its canonical real linear isometric pullback and M=B* its Hilbert adjoint. For every f∈L²(μ_y), (Bf)(x,p)=f(x) for ν_y-almost every (x,p). The operator norms satisfy ‖B‖≤1 and ‖M‖≤1, and MB is the identity on L²(μ_y). For every raw G∈L²(ν_y), p↦G(x,p) is γ-integrable for μ_y-almost every x, its Gaussian average ḡ(x)=∫G(x,p)dγ(p) lies in L²(μ_y), and M[G]=[ḡ]. Moreover JBf=Bf for every f and MJ=M.

Define K_T=M A_T B on L²(μ_y). Then K₀ is the identity, and for every T≥0 the operator K_T is self-adjoint and has norm at most one. For every raw f∈L²(μ_y), let k_Tf(x)=∫[∫f(π Z(y,r,(x,p),T,w))dP(w)]dγ(p). For μ_y-almost every x and then γ-almost every p the inner w-integrand is P-integrable; for μ_y-almost every x the inner expectation as a function of p is γ-integrable; k_Tf lies in L²(μ_y); and K_T[f]=[k_Tf]. All equalities of bracketed L² classes are quotient-space equalities, not everywhere equalities of chosen representatives.

The other displayed let-bindings specify finite histories, strict event-time simplexes, their induced Lebesgue measures, deterministic reconstructed records, products of completed-event rate/survival factors, terminal survival factors, and stitched finite paths; they add no hypotheses and no separate assertion about their laws. The conclusion does not state a semigroup or Markov identity, global nonexplosion, convergence to equilibrium, continuity at positive times, or additional regularity of the paths T↦Z(y,r,z₀,T,w).
scopes: The flow-record and fallback formulas quantify over every real-coordinate noise sequence, including atypical ones; initialization alone is stated only P-almost surely for each fixed y,r,z₀. Finite record times may coincide for exceptional inputs because thresholds can be zero; no universal strict-increase assertion is made. Event at T is included in the chosen post-event interval through t_n≤T<t_{n+1}; a stopped next record gives infinity and permits a last live interval. If no finite interval brackets T, fallback is exactly z₀. Inner noise integrability for L² phase data is only ν_y-almost everywhere in the initial phase state; Gaussian averaging is only μ_y-almost everywhere in x. For spatial data the order is μ_y-almost every x, then γ-almost every p, with w-integrability inside; integrability over p of the noise integral is a separate μ_y-AE assertion. Pullback representative identities are AE; operator identities and identities of L² classes are exact. Bounded raw-observable bounds and their noise integrability hold for every initial state. Strong convergence is norm convergence for each individual L² vector at nonnegative time 0, not uniform over vectors or operator-norm convergence. Dimension zero is allowed; reflection at zero gradient difference is identity; thresholds w_k≤0 become zero; τ may be infinite; nonnegative differences are truncated. For n=0 the simplex has the sole empty tuple, qReal=1 and strict successor conditions are vacuous; for T=0 and n>0 the simplex is empty. No regularity is imposed on the auxiliary Path type or asserted beyond the displayed global measurability and record formulas.
